review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — The CLI test seeds 25 matching files and checks for exit 1, the glob in the message, the count, the narrow/name request, and no rivetari/tasks branch. The check runs before reserveTaskId.
- A2: met — The CLI test drafts a card with a plain path, one with a 10-file glob and one with a glob matching nothing. The runtime test also accepts a glob matching exactly 20 files.
- A3: met — The CLI test with --from YAML refuses the over-cap glob and reserves no id.

<details><summary>4 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Confirm picomatch is already a declared dependency of the runtime package `packages/runtime/src/task/touches.ts:1` — If it isn't listed, ask first, then add picomatch and @types/picomatch to the runtime's package.json.
- The guard passes every glob when the path isn't a git repo `packages/runtime/src/task/touches.ts:12` — Either throw a CardError saying the touches can't be checked outside a git repo, or note in a comment why a non-repo is treated as having no tracked files.
- ls-files output is relative to repoPath, not the repo root `packages/runtime/src/task/touches.ts:15` — Run ls-files from the repo top level (resolve it with `rev-parse --show-toplevel`), or pass --full-name and list from the root.
- The CLI expands touches twice `packages/cli/src/commands/task.ts:229` — Leave as is for safety, or let newTask take an option to skip the check when the caller has already run it.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

suggestions.title: Confirm picomatch is already a declared dependency of the runtime package
suggestions.detail: touches.ts imports picomatch, and the diff doesn't change packages/runtime/package.json. If picomatch (and @types/picomatch) is only reachable transitively, pnpm's strict layout breaks typecheck and the build. If it has to be added, CONSTRAINTS.md says to ask before adding a dependency.
suggestions.repro: Check that packages/runtime/package.json lists picomatch in dependencies.
suggestions.fix: If it isn't listed, ask first, then add picomatch and @types/picomatch to the runtime's package.json.

suggestions.title: The guard passes every glob when the path isn't a git repo
suggestions.detail: When checkIsRepo() is false the check treats the repo as having no tracked files, so any glob passes. CONSTRAINTS.md says a guard that can't run reports red. The CLI path fails later at reserveTaskId anyway, so this only matters for direct newTask callers, which is why it isn't blocking.
suggestions.repro: newTask('/tmp/not-a-repo', {...card, touches: ['**']}, by) drafts the card.
suggestions.fix: Either throw a CardError saying the touches can't be checked outside a git repo, or note in a comment why a non-repo is treated as having no tracked files.

suggestions.title: ls-files output is relative to repoPath, not the repo root
suggestions.detail: Touches are repo-root-relative, but `git ls-files` run from a subdirectory lists paths relative to that directory and only for files under it. If repoPath is ever a subdirectory, a root-relative glob would undercount.
suggestions.fix: Run ls-files from the repo top level (resolve it with `rev-parse --show-toplevel`), or pass --full-name and list from the root.

suggestions.title: The CLI expands touches twice
suggestions.detail: runTaskNew calls checkTouches before reserving an id, and newTask runs the same check again. That means two git ls-files runs per draft. It's harmless, but it's redundant.
suggestions.repro: Run rivetari task new with a glob in --touches.
suggestions.fix: Leave as is for safety, or let newTask take an option to skip the check when the caller has already run it.
